buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 25% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 25 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 25 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration.

For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 25 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific Scope Of Work(SOW) Text Clause(s) 1. Withdrawn coins of different material compositions such as Cupro-Nickel (CN), Pure Nickel (PN), Alumini um-Bronze (Al-Br), Nickel-Brass (Ni-Br), Aluminium-Magnesium (Al-Mg) etc. to be segregated and weighed accordingly. 2. The successful bidder firm shall deploy suitable number of manpower for complete segregation & separation and weighment of all of withdrawn/uncurrent coins of denomination of 25 paise and below 25 p aise as per its metallic composition in presence/witness of IGMH staff and CISF personnel. 3.The manpower deployed by the bidder shall work inside the factory premises from 9:00 AM to 05:30 PM ( including 30 minutes’ recess for lunch) on all working days. 4.The successful bidder is required to submit the names of the workers along with their individual police ve rification reports and other necessary documents as deemed necessary. IGMH will verify the details and is sue gate pass for the listed persons accordingly. 5 Required PPE and other safety measures for the said workers are to be arranged by the bidder. All kinds of safety/security protocols to be complied by the bidder. 6. If the segregation & weighment is not done properly, the firm has to repeat the segregation work again t ill completion. 7. All denomination of 25 paise and below 25 paise coins from the total 100 MT withdrawn/uncurrent stock is to be separated material composition-wise within a period of maximum 3 months. The bidder firm is req uired to segregate minimum 30 MT of quantity of withdrawn/uncurrent stock per month. 3. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Eligibility Criteria: 1. The bidder should have capacity & capability to provide the relevant services and should submit the doc umentary evidence for the same. 2. The bidder should submit signed & stamped copy of tender document as a token of acceptance of all the terms & conditions of the tender document such as contract period, payment terms etc. 3. Payment Terms: Payment will be within 30 days after successfully completion of work/services and sub mission of bills and acceptance by IGMH. . 4. Service & Support AVAILABILITY OF OFFICE OF SERVICE PROVIDER: An office of the Service Provider must be located in the state of Consignee. DOCUMENTARY EVIDENCE TO BE SUBMITTED.
